**Going out:** Google-style search ad, headline "Plastic-Free Tea Bags", description with two claims. Audience: UK.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Plastic-Free Tea Bags" | Policy row: "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable" (supplier certificate, EN 13432). Supported. |
| "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable" | Exact policy wording. Supported. |
| "Founded in Bristol in 2019" | Exact policy wording (Companies House). Supported. |

**Regulated claims:** The environmental claims are specific, not broad ("green" or "eco-friendly"), and match the policy row with its certificate. No health, money, children, price or urgency language.

**House style:** No banned words, no AI tells, UK spelling, plain and warm enough for an ad. Score about 90/100. Nothing to rewrite.

**Disclosure:** Our own paid search ad. The platform marks it as an ad, and the policy requires no extra label. Pass.

**Fixed:** Nothing needed changing.

**Needs a decision:** Nothing unresolved. One note: the ad's landing page should show the plastic-free and compostable claim, since an ad can't claim more than its page backs up. Worth a quick look from Sam.
